title: FounderGate V8-B VB0 — Attached Projects Registry (persistent attach)
description: FounderGate's own persistent registry of attached projects. Records only paths + metadata — never any project's file content, and never a secret. Cross-project isolation is enforced in code (attached-projects.mjs): never auto-attach; the founder chooses the active project; no project's SECRET/blocked content or state bleeds into another; UNKNOWN when a project can't be read (Law 54).

active_id.description: The founder-chosen active project id, or null. NEVER auto-selected.
